label: Вон
description: A 10-sentence usage card for вон (over there, yonder).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Pointing to a distant place. 'Вон' is a demonstrative adverb directing attention to something far off, paired with 'там'. It marks a static location away from the speaker.
Strategic focus: Drawing the eye to a distance. 'Вон' points the listener's gaze toward a far object before 'видишь'. It marks a remote spot the speaker is indicating by hand.
Strategic focus: Pointing at a moving figure. 'Вон' singles out someone approaching at a distance, modifying the scene of 'идёт'. It is a lively, spoken way to point a person out.
Strategic focus: Pointing to a destination. 'Вон' combines with 'туда' to indicate a far spot for the motion of 'положи'. It directs the action toward a place the speaker gestures at.
Strategic focus: Locating a distant activity. 'Вон' with 'там' marks a far-off place where the fishing happens. It frames a static location the speaker points to across a distance.
Strategic focus: Pointing out a striking sight. 'Вон' here adds emphasis as it draws attention to the scene, an exclamatory spoken use. It marks the speaker calling notice to the many birds.
Strategic focus: Indicating a place around the corner. 'Вон' points toward the location named by 'за тем углом'. It marks a static spot the speaker is gesturing toward.
Strategic focus: Calling attention with a gesture. 'Вон' opens the sentence to point out the cat at a distance. It is a casual spoken signal to look where the speaker indicates.
Strategic focus: Pointing toward a room. 'Вон' marks a distant room as the goal of 'иди', combined with 'в ту комнату'. It directs the motion toward a place the speaker shows.

missions.phrase: Вон на той полке твоя книга.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Locating an object far off. 'Вон' points to the shelf named by 'на той полке' where the book sits. It marks a static, distant location the speaker indicates.
